content.value: Write a structure declaration for the following situations. Assume an 8-bit integer word. Define four (12) bit fields, called a, b; c and d, whose widths are 6 bits, 6 bits, 3 bits and 5 bits respectively. Force b to beginning of the second word of storage. Separate b and c with 10 vacant bits.
